title: hapax-spine
description: Source-available runtime mechanism from Hapax Research Lab (BSL 1.1): append-only event ledgers, policy-backed routing, receipts, quotas, EDT, projections. The mechanism layer behind Reins; not a general-purpose lifecycle kernel.
notes: Repository license: Business Source License 1.1 (source-available, non-Open-Source until the Change Date converts the work to Apache-2.0; source inspection is open while competing hosted-service use remains reserved).
